summary: New nonfinancial shadows now durably checkpoint the original feature vector and its three original proof attrs, opening reference/time, fixed runner profile, context, observed peak and original one-partial prefix. The address-owned state slot carries an instance, checksum and checked generation; updates cannot replace an original entry, frozen close, newer instance or newer generation. Original opening/partial events have stable nonfinancial IDs and clocks, acknowledged only after confirmed native journal/portfolio effects. Prospective shadow-opening ledger writes are idempotent under a stable OS guard; legacy diagnostic ledger conventions remain unchanged. The independent serial shadow actor restores saved states with a bounded rotating cursor, retries pending effects before price work, retains missingness and retires only an identical completed close outbox. A lost retirement acknowledgement restores the frozen close without refetching or leaving stale opening context. No legacy portfolio or historical feature/outcome/model data is reconstructed or relabelled. Three actual native-wrapper restart probes failed before implementation; new source checks and broader validation are recorded separately. Durability begins only after atomic publication, not before admission or as a hardware guarantee. Original birth/risk/quote/sizing/training/activation contracts are unchanged; this is neither financial-fill recovery nor proof of profitable capture. All operational runtime, training, AutoResearch, API/UI and LIVE processes remain off. The original whole goal and independent provider/full-strategy/financial acceptance remain incomplete.

state_contract.scope: Prospectively saved nonfinancial shadow tracking only; no buy/sell or financial outcome authority
state_contract.entry: Original feature values and proof attrs, opened_at, buy reference, fixed profile and context cannot drift between generations
state_contract.async_input_boundary: Detach original vector/proof attrs and rank metadata before the first price lookup yields
state_contract.size_boundary: Active admission retains the original 1 MiB bound; a closing checkpoint accounts for both the original state and separately bounded native 1 MiB close instead of rejecting an already admitted large vector
state_contract.ownership: One hashed address slot, stable OS guard, 32-hex instance, checksum and checked generation; another instance or stale generation is rejected
state_contract.partial: Single original simulated partial event, its fraction and price-return prefix are consistent with retained quantity and realized ratio
state_contract.events: Saved opening/partial ID and observed_at survive retries; strict True acknowledges publication, not None/1/False
state_contract.close: Saved original frozen close cannot be replaced; retire only after exact native completed outbox identity and checksum match
state_contract.recovery: At most 32 active files per normal monitor tick, validated configurable budget up to 256 and rotating cursor; corrupt records do not starve later states
state_contract.historical: Missing legacy full state remains missing; no inferred original vector, opening price, partial prefix or decision clock
state_contract.cancellation: Native IO owner drains repeated cancellation; a saved-but-unacknowledged opening is recovered instead of silently abandoned
state_contract.import: Cold module import starts no disk state, workers, provider request or child process

limits: Atomic fsync/replace protects admitted records from partial process writes, not every filesystem or hardware power-loss scenario
A crash before confirmed state admission can lose an unacknowledged observation; no earlier durability is claimed
Checksums and retained feature attrs do not independently authenticate the complete executing process, source availability or provider market-asof
Only the existing one-partial shadow policy is recovered; the separate real/PAPER trade execution and multi-step runner contracts are unchanged
Corrupt or conflicting records remain pending and are not auto-repaired or silently removed
The original journal and decision ledger are scanned for idempotence; production-size IO latency/SLA and all failure-tail files remain unmeasured
Legacy diagnostic ledger errors remain best effort and are not profitable-strategy evidence
The historical isolated Windows model/birth consistency failure cause remains unresolved despite later passing revisions
Current-revision full two-OS CI and actual provider/full-strategy/prospective net-profit acceptance remain separate and incomplete
